Ten easy habits for better sleep

Good sleep starts with a regular routine. Going to bed and waking up at the same time every day helps the body clock settle, even on weekends.

Keep the bedroom cool, dark and quiet. Avoid heavy meals and caffeine in the late afternoon, and put your phone away at least thirty minutes before bed.
